title: Michael Johnson vanishes with no records

tellings.quote: said yeah I agree with that that was the last time I ever saw him

plain: After the night in 1977 when two Air Force guards say they were taken by aliens at a missile site near Rapid City, South Dakota, one of them, Michael Johnson, disappeared from the other's life with no records left behind. Mario Woods, a former nuclear weapons guard and the other man, tells it himself: after a final conversation where they agreed on what had happened, "that was the last time I ever saw him," which would suggest someone moved Johnson out of sight.
